items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I believe that it was writer /critic Dan Morganstern in his evaluation of Eddie Condon.

ctx.x: So many have asked how come I worked with so many great black musicians and groups, and my answer -- they liked my playing first, and then me personally, I suppose. As I did them.

God has been kind to me, to bestow me with a sense and feeling of love for all people -- and enough talent for them to accept me as a participating fellow musician. It brings to mind an observation -- and I believe that it was writer /critic Dan Morganstern in his evaluation of Eddie Condon. He said Eddie Condon ignored the racial issue as if it didn't exist. And them is my sentiments.
Of course you realize it's there, and it does exist to too many people.
